title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Seller Who Retains Ownership of a Vehicle Purchased by Installments and Used for Transport Causing Property Damage to Others in a Traffic Accident Shall Not Bear Civil Liability

articles.content_en:
FaShi [2000] No. 38
Sichuan Higher People's Court:
Your Court's Chuan Gao Fa [1999] No. 2 Request for Instructions titled "On Whether the Seller Shall Bear Civil Liability for Losses Caused to Others by the Buyer Using the Vehicle for Goods Transportation During the Performance of a Vehicle Sales Contract with Installment Payment and Retained Ownership" has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:
For a vehicle purchased by installment payment, where the seller retains ownership until the buyer pays all amounts, if the buyer enters into a cargo transportation contract with others in its own name and uses the vehicle for transportation, and causes property losses to others due to a traffic accident, the seller shall not bear civil liability.
This is our reply.
